account:link.title: Save your progress
account:link.title__note: Screen title for attaching an email to an anonymous account. Max 24 characters.
account:link.body: Add an email and your streak, your XP and everything you have learned come with you to a new phone. We use it to sign you back in and for nothing else.
account:link.body__note: Under the title. States the benefit first and the whole use of the address second, because the second is what people hesitate over.
account:signIn.title: Sign in
account:signIn.title__note: Screen title for returning to an existing account. Max 16 characters.
account:signIn.body: Enter the email you saved your progress with and we will send you a code.
account:signIn.warning.title: There is progress on this phone
account:signIn.warning.title__note: Heading of the warning shown when signing in would strand unsaved local progress. States a fact, never scolds. Max 40 characters.
account:signIn.warning.body: {count, plural, one {You have a # day streak here that is not saved to an account. Signing in switches to your other account and leaves this behind.} other {You have a # day streak here that is not saved to an account. Signing in switches to your other account and leaves this behind.}}
account:signIn.warning.body__note: The specific number is the point — a person stops and reads 'your 14 day streak' and taps past 'you may lose data'.
account:signIn.warning.cta__note: Switches to the link flow, which keeps what is on this phone. Max 30 characters.
account:email.label: Email
account:email.label__note: Spoken label of the email field. Max 12 characters.
account:email.placeholder__note: Placeholder in the email field. Use an address that reads as an example in your language.
account:email.cta__note: Submits the email address. Max 20 characters.
account:code.body: We sent a six-digit code to {email}. It expires in an hour.
account:code.body__note: Naming the address is what makes a typo findable at a glance. Max 80 characters.
account:code.label: Six-digit code
account:code.label__note: Spoken label of the code field. Max 20 characters.
account:code.placeholder__note: Placeholder in the code field. Digits only — keep it six characters.
account:code.wrongEmail__note: Goes back to the address field. Max 26 characters.
account:done.link.title: Your progress is safe
account:done.link.title__note: Shown after an email is confirmed. Says what is now true rather than 'Success'. Max 30 characters.
account:done.link.body: Sign in with this email on any phone and everything you have learned will be there.
account:done.signIn.title: Welcome back
account:done.signIn.title__note: Shown after signing in on a new device. Max 24 characters.
account:done.cta__note: Leaves the account screen. Max 20 characters.
account:error.noAccount: We have no account for that email. Check the spelling, or save this phone's progress instead.
account:error.noAccount__note: Shown when signing in with an address that has never been used. Naming both fixes matters — the address is usually just mistyped.
account:error.badCode: That code is not right. Check it and try again.
account:error.badCode__note: Wrong or expired six-digit code. No blame, no attempt counter. Max 70 characters.
account:error.taken: That email is already on another account. Sign in with it instead.
account:error.taken__note: Shown when linking an address that belongs to someone else's account. Max 80 characters.
account:error.generic: That didn't work. Check your connection and try again.
account:error.generic__note: Anything we cannot name. Never shows a raw error to the user. Max 70 characters.
account:settings.email__note: Settings row label; the address is shown beside it. Max 20 characters.
account:settings.anonymous__note: Settings row label when nothing is saved. A fact, not a warning. Max 20 characters.
account:settings.link__note: Settings row that opens the link flow. Max 24 characters.
account:settings.signIn__note: Settings row that opens the sign-in flow. Max 30 characters.
account:settings.signOut__note: Ends the session and clears this device. Max 16 characters.
account:settings.child: Progress on this phone stays on this phone. Ask a grown-up if you want to keep it somewhere safe.
account:settings.child__note: Shown instead of the account rows on an under-13 account, where we must not collect an email address. Plain words a ten-year-old reads without alarm.
account:offline.title: You are offline
account:offline.title__note: Shown on the account screen with no connection. This is the one flow in the app that cannot work offline. Max 24 characters.
account:offline.body: Saving your progress needs a connection. Everything you learn keeps working without one — come back to this when you are online.
account:offline.body__note: Reassures that the rest of the app is unaffected, which is true and is the thing a user actually worries about here.
